exec git init -b main
env TZ=UTC
at 2026-07-20T12:00:00Z
exec card init --prefix scope- --board-name 'Alpha board'
exec card board create 'Beta board'
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/beta-board.txt

# Mailboxes and subscriptions span boards in the same store.
exec card --board board_00000000000000000000 --actor alice mail send bob 'direct across boards'
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/direct-send.txt
exec card --board board_11111111111111111111 --actor bob mail recv --peek
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/direct-recv.txt
exec card --board board_00000000000000000000 --actor carol mail subscribe 'release.*' --ttl 1h
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/subscription.txt
exec card --board board_11111111111111111111 --actor alice mail publish release.ready 'topic across boards'
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/topic-send.txt
exec card --board board_11111111111111111111 --actor carol mail recv --peek
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/topic-recv.txt

# A lease acquired from one board excludes actors working in another board.
exec card --board board_00000000000000000000 --actor alice lease acquire shared-environment --ttl 30m
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/lease.txt
exec card --board board_11111111111111111111 --actor alice lease show shared-environment
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/lease.txt
! exec card --board board_11111111111111111111 --actor bob lease acquire shared-environment --ttl 30m
cmp stderr $WORK/golden/lease-held.txt

-- golden/beta-board.txt --
board_11111111111111111111
-- golden/direct-send.txt --
mail_00000000000000000000000000000001	alice	bob		2026-07-20T12:00:00Z	2026-07-27T12:00:00Z
direct across boards
-- golden/direct-recv.txt --
mail_00000000000000000000000000000001	alice	bob		2026-07-20T12:00:00Z	2026-07-27T12:00:00Z
direct across boards
-- golden/subscription.txt --
carol	release.*	2026-07-20T12:00:00Z	2026-07-20T13:00:00Z
-- golden/topic-send.txt --
mail_00000000000000000000000000000002	alice	carol	release.ready	2026-07-20T12:00:00Z	2026-07-27T12:00:00Z
topic across boards
-- golden/topic-recv.txt --
mail_00000000000000000000000000000002	alice	carol	release.ready	2026-07-20T12:00:00Z	2026-07-27T12:00:00Z
topic across boards
-- golden/lease.txt --
shared-environment	alice	2026-07-20T12:00:00Z	2026-07-20T12:30:00Z
-- golden/lease-held.txt --
error: lease "shared-environment" is held by "alice" until 2026-07-20T12:30:00Z
